response_window.formula: t_j=(j-1)*BIN_SHIFT; average frames with t_j-BIN_WIDTH < relative_time <= t_j
response_window.comment_conflict: author function header says bin center, executable assignments save binEnd
response_window.conditions: BIN_WIDTH=BIN_SHIFT=1/120 as used by pinned L2 selection and filter scripts; exact upstream small-file export not proven

notebook_input.recurrence_interval_caveat: input[i] advances output[i-1] to output[i]. Under preceding-interval holding, nonzero integration intervals span (1/120,4/120] rather than left-held plotted [2/120,5/120). Neither interpretation independently measures latency.
notebook_input.fitted_delay: paper explicitly sweeps input delay and selects 16.7 ms; consistent with nominal index2, not independent physiological measurement

area_preserving_discretization_example.assumption: 20 ms pulse begins exactly at a grid boundary; arithmetic example only, not applied and not a reproduction claim

sign.stored_quantity: context-supported raw dF/F; conditional on verifying aggregate export lineage
sign.display: negative raw fluorescence; additionally multiply by100 for negative percent dF/F
sign.inv_option: reverses plot axis, does not negate stored rats in inspected filter/export chain

normalization.reason: subtracting joint trace mean does not generally preserve gray-baseline zero
normalization.overwrite: lowLum mean_res2 is overwritten by highLum row0 before fitting

author_observation_map.latent_units: effective modeled activity; not absolute mV or release
author_observation_map.first_sample: v0=-z_target0; returned z_hat0=z_target0 bypasses affine map
author_observation_map.downstream_initialization_effect: not quantified by this arithmetic audit

validation_policy: Split by biological fly before fitting; keep repeats and both polarities together.
Do not treat126 response entries as126 independent biological samples.
An aggregate fit is descriptive calibration, not independent validation.
Any successful L2 boundary result cannot on its own pass whole-CNS vision, conditioning or game-learning gates.
